Home / About

The independent network behind the fights.

VAL TV Network Sports & Entertainment is an independent television production and distribution platform based in Las Vegas, Nevada.

Founder

Valerie McConnell

Valerie Glenzell McConnell is the Founder and Independent Broadcast Distributor of VAL TV Network. She has produced and hosted more than 100 television programs, featuring interviews with athletes, coverage of major sporting events and original entertainment programming.

In March 2020 she launched her first production facility, VAL TV Studio, producing interviews, television segments and live discussions from Las Vegas. She later expanded through studio collaborations including VegasPlus.us Studio, operated by IMEX Studios, and MDD’s Consultant Studios.

Valerie is also part of the television legacy of Soul Train, created by Don Cornelius.

Honors and recognition

  • United States Congressional RecognitionCertificate of Special Congressional Recognition for service to the community.
  • City of Los AngelesCertificate of Recognition connected to the legacy of Soul Train dancers.
  • City of Chicago ProclamationMarking the 55th anniversary of Soul Train dancers.
  • Mayor’s Office, City of ChicagoLetter of recognition for the Soul Train dance movement.

Championship boxing

Press conferences, training camps and fight events, with world champions such as Claressa Shields, in Las Vegas and Detroit.

Las Vegas fight week

Media days and promotional events for Premier Boxing Champions, Golden Boy Promotions and Top Rank.

HBCU Las Vegas Classic

A mini-series on Jackson State vs. Grambling State, broadcast through Cox Communications platforms.
